'''Hityamun "Hitch" Kris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] and a former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who turned his back on his clan to join the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. He was once in a relationship with holostar [[Javul Charn]], the two were engaged into a marriage before Javul broke it off once she discovered Hityamum had been smuggling illegal goods aboard her [[starship]]. Despite being a former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], most of his bodyguards were seen in [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] besides one, indicating he still has ties to his former culture.<ref name="SG" />
